name: asana_list_workspaces
description: Get all accessible Asana workspaces. Returns workspace names and IDs needed to list projects and tasks.

name: asana_list_tasks
description: List tasks in a project. Returns task ID, name, completion status, assignee, and due date. Requires project ID.

completed_since.description: Only return tasks completed since this date (ISO 8601). Use "now" for incomplete tasks only.

limit.description: Number of tasks to return (default 20, max 100)

name: asana_get_task
description: Get full task details including name, description, assignee, projects, tags, subtasks, and status. Requires task ID.

name: asana_create_task
description: Create a new task in a project. Returns task ID, name, and permalink. Requires project ID and task name.

projects.description: Comma-separated project GIDs to add the task to

name: asana_list_projects
description: List all projects in a workspace. Returns project ID, name, and archived status. Requires workspace ID.

limit.description: Number of projects to return (default 20, max 100)

name: asana_search_tasks
description: Search tasks across a workspace by keyword. Returns matching tasks with ID, name, completion status, and assignee. Requires workspace ID.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)
